verdicts.label: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The claim is about a future event on October 4, 2026, and therefore cannot be verified or disproven at this time. While crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake on numerous occasions in the past, there is no evidence for this specific future event.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The claim makes a specific assertion about an event on a future date (October 4, 2026). It is impossible to verify or debunk an event that has not yet occurred. While multiple news reports confirm that crocodiles have been present in Kukkarahalli Lake over many years, this contextual information cannot be used to assess the validity of a claim about a specific future sighting. Therefore, there is not enough evidence to support or refute the claim.
